offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures freight railcars, mainly aluminum-bodied coal cars plus other open-top hoppers and gondolas, for railroads, lessors and shippers. Builds mainly at its Castaños, Mexico plant. Also rebuilds and repairs railcars, sells parts, and leases railcars.

primary_products.value: aluminum coal railcars; open-top hopper cars; gondola cars; covered hopper cars; railcar parts

primary_services.value: railcar repair and rebuilding; railcar leasing; railcar conversion and refurbishment

customer_segment.value: B2B: railroads, railcar lessors, shippers and utilities that need freight railcars

end_markets.value: rail freight transportation; coal and bulk commodities; railcar leasing; steel and aggregates

revenue_model.value: product sales: new freight railcars built to order, and parts; service fees: railcar repair and rebuild work; rental or leasing: leased railcars from company-owned fleet
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds railcars from purchased steel, aluminum and components, sold to railroads, lessors and shippers

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada and Mexico, manufacturing in Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: new railcars, railcar rebuilds and parts, and leasing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales to railroads, lessors and shippers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: railcar safety and design standards from the Association of American Railroads and Federal Railroad Administration, trade and tariff rules

notes: Product mix and leasing scale are approximate.
